title: dillenia indica var. aurea
intro: Dillenia indica var. aurea, commonly known as Golden Banana-Shrub, is a variety of flowering plant in the family Dilleniaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal and ornamental properties, with the golden variety being a popular choice for its vibrant golden foliage. The health benefits of Dillenia indica var. aurea include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to protect against chronic diseases such as heart disease and cancer. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial, anti-diabetic, and anti-cancer activities.
